Information you provide by using the Platform, such as by completing forms and/or registering on the Platform, such as your name, email address, mailing address, or telephone number, or by posting User content if permitted. Details of any requests or transactions you make through the Platform. Information that is not personally identifiable, but that relates to your usage of the Platform or that is aids in the proper functioning or improvement of the Platform, including: (i) times and dates and the extent of your usage of the Platform; (ii) time zone, language, screen resolution, and other usage preferences you select when using the Platform; (iii) device keyboard settings; (iv) usage h
Communications you send to Uplink, such as when you request support, submit comments or questions, or answer surveys or report a problem to Uplink.

. For more information about our use of data analytics to protect and improve our Platform, see Cookies and How We Utilize Them below.
Uplink also collects and maintains aggregated, anonymized, or pseudonymized information to protect the safety and security of the Platform, improve the Platform, or comply with its legal obligations.
You may decline to provide Uplink with some or all of your information. However, this will limit your ability to use the Platform.
Types of Cookies Uplink Utilizes
Uplink uses the following types of cookies and other technologies:
Security:
Uplink secures the Platform with cookies that facilitate security features and allow Uplink to detect activity that might violate the
Terms and Conditions
, such as unauthorized access or activity.
Localization:
Some cookies help Uplink provide localized experiences, such as displaying the Platform in the local language.
Site Features and Services
: Certain cookies provide greater functionality to the Platform and help Uplink deliver our products and services.
Performance:
Uplink uses performance cookies to help route traffic between servers and understand how the Platform is performing so Uplink can provide Users with the best experience possible.
Analytics and Research:
Cookies and other technologies also help Uplink to understand, improve, and research features and content on the Platform, such as by using Google Analytics, which you can opt out of at
https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout
Marketing and Online Behavioral Advertising:

Cookies help us deliver targeted advertisements through web browsers and on social media platforms based on your activity on the Platform and to track the performance of those ads. In some cases, our partners may use cookies to provide us with information about your interactions with their services. Those third-party cookies would be subject to such third-party service's privacy policies. The Self

to opt out of having your online behavior collected for advertising purposes.
Limiting or Blocking Cookies and Our Do Not Track Policy

Your browser may give you the ability to control cookies, which may depend on the type of cookie, and browsers can be set to reject browser cookies. However, blocking or deleting cookies may prevent you from using most of the Platform.

Some browsers have “do not track” features that allow you to tell a website not to track you. These features are not all uniform. If you block cookies, certain features on the Platform may not work. If you block or reject cookies, not all of the tracking described in this Privacy Policy will necessarily stop.
Note that certain options you select are specific to certain browsers and devices.
Web Beacons

The Platform may contain electronic images known as web beacons (sometimes called single-pixel gifs) and are used along with cookies to compile aggregated statistics to analyze how the Platform is used.

Uplink may need your personal data to comply with contractual obligations to deliver the Platform, such as fulfilling subscriptions or transactions made through the Platform.
Legal Obligations:
Sometimes the law requires the collection and use of your data, such as applicable tax laws may require Uplink to retain records of payments made through the Platform.
